Values read from a graph are estimates limited by scale and curve thickness. Check axis units and tick spacing; estimate a tangent’s slope using two reasonably separated points on the tangent. Distinguish interpolation within observations from extrapolation beyond them.
Read approximate concentrations[0,6,7.4,6.7,5.4,4.1,3,2.2,1.5]mg/L at2second intervals.The result is a graphical estimate.

check.ko: 적분 구간과 단위를 확인한다. 수량이 천 단위이면 달러 환산에1000을 곱하고,초당 유량은60을 곱해 분당 유량으로 바꾼다.
check.en: Check bounds and units.Multiply thousand-unit quantities by1000 for dollars; multiply flow per second by60 for flow per minute.

caption.ko: 제시된 표 또는 원본 그래프의 근사 표본을 이은 도해. 적분은 Simpson 가중합으로 계산한다.
caption.en: Diagram joining tabulated or graph-estimated samples.Integration uses Simpson weights.
